comment: Test prefab. 3x2x3: a cobble pad with a chest on it and a torch beside. Blocks are [x, y, z, blockId, variant] in prefab-local coords; variant is the raw high byte, so chest facing / slab halves / log widths all survive. `loot` maps a prefab-local cell to a table in `lootTables` below — by key ("1") or by that table's `name` ("basic").

spawn._mode: surface = flat ground only, sits on top. embed = anchors on the lowest ground in the footprint, carves the hillside out of its walls and pillars any overhang, so it never floats. air = ignores the ground entirely and picks a random height inside minY..maxY. cave = drops into a cavern that already exists, needs an open pocket on a solid floor and carves nothing. underground = digs its own room, needs solid rock through the volume plus a one-block shell, then hollows it out.
spawn._minY_maxY: for surface/embed these filter the terrain height; for air/cave/underground they ARE the band the prefab is placed in. cave/underground also stay at least 3 blocks below the surface.
